name: expand the deepest node first
mechanism: follow one branch as far as it goes before returning to try the next, using a stack; discovery and finishing times give low-links, components and topological orders

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Depth-first search' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: traverses a graph branch by branch
